Hi — thank you for the patience. Please find our package attached and answers summarized inline below. Full attachments are: Redwood_SIG_Response_2027-05-04.pdf, no-train-evidence-summary.txt, DPIA-summary-MedSys-2027.pdf. If you need additional samples under NDA, let us know and we'll route the SOC 2 report request.

Quick summary (high-level answers):

1) Training on customer data
- Redwood Inference does NOT use customer-provided prompts or generated responses to train or update any shared/open models by default. Model training pipelines are separated from the inference runtime; there are configuration gates ("data_collection_enabled") that must be explicitly set per-customer and documented in the contract. See attached no-train-evidence-summary.txt for config excerpts and redacted log samples showing the collection flag off for MedSys tenancy.

2) Prompt/response storage and retention (DPIA summary)
- Default retention: ephemeral logs for 30 days for observability; token-level logs used for cost/usage are retained per-customer policy and can be configured to 0 days for strict opt-out customers.
- Pseudonymization: customer identifiers are hashed, and PII redaction is available via a configurable pipeline. The DPIA-summary-MedSys-2027.pdf outlines the flow, data minimization steps, and retention controls.

3) SIG/CAIQ and SOC 2
- Attached: Redwood_SIG_Response_2027-05-04.pdf (completed SIG answers keyed to CAIQ controls).
- SOC 2: we provide report metadata in the SIG and can share the full report under an NDA. If you want Calyx to review the full report, Jasmine will coordinate access.

4) HIPAA / healthcare controls
- Redwood offers a BAA and has documented key management (KMS/HSM), encryption at rest/in transit, and audit logging. Soojin included a short HIPAA controls section in the DPIA PDF.

Attachments (stubs included):
- Redwood_SIG_Response_2027-05-04.pdf (SIG answers + CAIQ mapping; 14 pages)
- no-train-evidence-summary.txt (redacted log lines, config flag excerpts, YAML snippets)
- DPIA-summary-MedSys-2027.pdf (3 pages)

Elena / Calyx: please confirm if the attached SIG/CAIQ PDF format works for your validation or if you prefer a spreadsheet export.

- If MedSys wants permanent opt-out of any prompt/response retention, we can apply a per-tenant policy (zero retention) and document the change request in HubSpot (Deal: MS-2027-0198).
